title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on John 16: sorrow turned into joy, the work of the Spirit of truth, and overcoming the world.

questions.text: What does Jesus say will be done to his disciples?
questions.explanation: He says that they will put them out of the synagogues, and that the time comes when whoever kills them will think he offers service to God.

answers.text: They will be put out of the synagogues
They will be made rulers
They will suffer nothing at all
They will be sent to the Greeks

questions.text: What had filled the disciples' heart because of what Jesus told them?
questions.explanation: He says that because he has told them these things, sorrow has filled their heart.

answers.text: Joy
Sorrow
Peace
Anger

questions.text: Why does Jesus say it is to their advantage that he goes away?
questions.explanation: He says that if he does not go away, the Counselor will not come to them, but if he goes, he will send him to them.

answers.text: Otherwise the world would hate them more
Otherwise they would bear no fruit
Otherwise the Counselor will not come
Otherwise they would be put out of the synagogue

questions.text: About what three things will the Counselor convict the world?
questions.explanation: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment.

answers.text: The law, the prophets and the psalms
Sin, death and the law
The Father, the Son and the world
Sin, righteousness and judgment

questions.text: What will the Spirit of truth do when he has come?
questions.explanation: He will guide them into all truth, will not speak from himself, and will declare to them things that are coming.

answers.text: Speak only from himself
Guide them into all truth
Take away all their questions
Convict them of their own sin

questions.text: What image does Jesus use for sorrow that turns into joy?
questions.explanation: He speaks of a woman who has sorrow when she gives birth, but does not remember the anguish for the joy that a child is born.

answers.text: A woman giving birth to a child
A grain of wheat in the earth
A branch pruned by the farmer
A shepherd finding his sheep

questions.text: What does Jesus say about the joy they will have when he sees them again?
questions.explanation: He says their heart will rejoice, and that no one will take their joy away from them.

answers.text: It will last only a little while
The world will share it with them
It will come only after the judgment
No one will take it away from them

questions.text: How had Jesus been speaking to them until that time?
questions.explanation: He says he has spoken these things to them in figures of speech, but that the time is coming when he will tell them plainly about the Father.

answers.text: Plainly about the Father
In the words of the law
In figures of speech
In the words of Isaiah the prophet

questions.text: What did the disciples say they now knew about him?
questions.explanation: They said that now they know that he knows all things and does not need anyone to question him.

answers.text: That he knows all things
That he would not leave them
That their sorrow would not return
That they would not be scattered

questions.text: What does Jesus say at the end of this chapter about the world?
questions.explanation: He says that in the world they have trouble, but tells them to cheer up, because he has overcome the world.

answers.text: The world will give them peace
They will have no trouble
He has overcome the world
The world has overcome him
